text: the tree physics feel a bit clunky, like i can get through the purple gap here but not the red [Image #1]
resolution: Changed data-recipe prop collision so compact round in-band props, including tree trunks, no longer fall back to one square footprint. The collider generator now emits seven narrow local strips for round single-cluster footprints, trimming the artificial square corners that were closing diagonal gaps while keeping side/front trunk blocking. Added a placed-piece test proving oak trunks still block on their visible sides but no longer occupy the old AABB corner. Verified the focused build-placed suite is green and hmsc-int ships successfully; the broader game verify remains red from pre-existing unrelated oracle/Workbench alias failures.
